shots.camText: Opens exactly on Q13's last frame: frontal two-shot from the kerb · 28 mm · locked-off
shots.note: He does not laugh; his face calm. She looks down. People pass along the pavement.

shots.camText: Insert at pavement height: her boot against the paper bag · 50 mm · handheld, nearly still
shots.note: Her boot is touching the lunch bag again.

shots.camText: Oren in right profile, close-up, from the kerb · 85 mm · locked-off
shots.line: OREN: "I can't add to the appeal. It needs a person to open it."
shots.note: He turns to her; the laundrette window soft behind him; the fine seam below his right ear.

lines.text: OREN: I can't add to the appeal. It needs a person to open it.

shots.camText: Helena, close-up · 65 mm · handheld, a slow push-in
shots.line: OREN (off-screen, over her): "The clinic has a benefits adviser today. May I ask them?" · HELENA: "You can ask. No promise?"
shots.note: Her lips closed while he speaks: her brows lift with hope, then her lips press it down. Then, guarded, her line.

lines.text: OREN (off-screen): The clinic has a benefits adviser today. May I ask them?
HELENA: You can ask. No promise?

shots.camText: Oren, frontal close-up, centred · 65 mm · locked-off
shots.line: OREN: "No. I cannot approve the appeal."

lines.text: OREN: No. I cannot approve the appeal.

shots.camText: Helena in left profile, close-up, from the kerb · 85 mm · handheld
shots.line: HELENA: "Good. I don't need another congratulations before anything's happened."
shots.note: The mirror of shot 3 (the board's Helena cannot turn her head: she faces him, frame left). A bitter one-sided smile, at the system, not at him; her eyes open, on him.

lines.text: HELENA: Good. I don't need another congratulations before anything's happened.
